raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 2026-01-15 CRM migration introduced numeric region codes ('01'-'04') in raw_customers, and silver_customers passes them through unmapped. raw_region_map is a one-to-one reference from those codes to the standard region names, so joining it in resolves the values.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
